project_type: Texora monorepo: Tauri v2 + React/TS shell (apps/desktop) + Python 3.11 FastAPI engine sidecar (engine/). M3 is ENGINE-SIDE ONLY.
language: Python 3.11 (engine). Full type hints, mypy-strict. Pydantic v2 models for all API I/O and config.
build_system: Engine: pip + a per-worktree venv (gitignored). No uv in this worktree. torch/torchvision +cpu wheels come from the PyTorch CPU index, so pip install MUST pass --extra-index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu. The M3 engine venv at engine/.venv does NOT yet exist in this worktree and must be created in FEAT-001.
test_framework: pytest (engine/tests). Real fixtures for recognition/layout (NO mocked OCR in production paths). Golden-file fixtures for exporters. Model-backed tests use @pytest.mark.model + skip-with-reason when weights absent (established M2 pattern). LaTeX-compile test uses @pytest.mark.latex and xfail-skips locally (no TeX toolchain on this host).
build_command: No separate compile step for Python; the gate IS lint+type+test. Run from engine/: .venv/Scripts/python.exe -m ruff check . ; .venv/Scripts/python.exe -m black --check . --line-length 100 ; .venv/Scripts/python.exe -m mypy texora_engine
test_command: From engine/: .venv/Scripts/python.exe -m pytest -q (full suite). Per-feature, run the named test modules first, then the full suite.
verification_instructions: ALWAYS prepend this PATH export before any shell command: export PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$LOCALAPPDATA/Programs/Python/Python311:$LOCALAPPDATA/Programs/Python/Python311/Scripts:$LOCALAPPDATA/Microsoft/WinGet/Packages/pnpm.pnpm_Microsoft.Winget.Source_8wekyb3d8bbwe:$PATH". Use the worktree venv interpreter engine/.venv/Scripts/python.exe for ALL engine commands, run from the engine/ dir. After EVERY feature the full engine gate (ruff check . ; black --check . --line-length 100 ; mypy texora_engine ; pytest -q) must pass. Record REAL command output in docs/m3-verification.md (mirror docs/m2-verification.md). Tick tasks.md [x] ONLY for criteria actually met on this host; record host-limited items as PENDING, never a false tick.

The born_digital_math.pdf fixture is generated reproducibly via a scripts/ synthetic-PDF generator (regenerable, license-clean). The KaTeX allowlist (ensemble/katex_allowlist.json) already exists from M2 and is reused unchanged by the LaTeX validator. No other generated-then-committed files.

(3) CPU host -> CUDA EP unverifiable, code-review only, flag PENDING.
contribution_requirements: Steering (.kiro/steering/*.md): NO placeholder/stub or fake outputs in production paths; NO mocked OCR outside tests. Pin dependency versions; verify every library/model against official docs before use. mypy clean, black-formatted (line-length 100), ruff clean. Pydantic v2 for all API I/O + config; no untyped dicts across module boundaries. Engine adapters implement the Protocol in recognizers/base.py or layout/base.py with a stable id and pure recognize/detect returning typed results; register in the factory, never hard-wire into API/UI. Structured logging via get_logger; no bare print. Per-region timeouts + bounded concurrency; free bitmaps promptly. SQLite only via db/. Config via pipeline.yaml + pydantic-settings; no magic constants. Permissive-first: AGPL/non-commercial engines are opt-in only, never the shipped default, never registered in the default factory. docs/LICENSES.md row for every new dep/model in the same change. >80% coverage target on core logic.
key_patterns: Factory pattern (recognizers/factory.py): frozen _Entry(id, model_ids, ctor); _REGISTRY: dict[str,_Entry] keyed by adapter.id; build_*(settings, model_store) reads load_pipeline_config().stages.*, raises typed StageNotConfigured / UnknownEngineError (never a silent default), resolves weights via model_store.require_ready(mid).file_path(name). M3 layout/text factories resolve EVERY id in model_ids via a dict-comprehension (design S2.1), not just model_ids[0]. Protocol pattern (recognizers/base.py): @runtime_checkable Protocol with id/model_ids attrs + pure method returning a Pydantic result; adapters catch their own errors and return status=FAILED/empty, NEVER raise, NEVER fabricate. Shared enums RecognitionStatus (ok|needs_review|failed), ConfidenceKind (token_logprob|unavailable), and RegionContext(is_display, device, source) are reused across formula+text+layout. Catalog (models/catalog.py): ModelSpec(id, version, license, target_dir, files=[ModelFile(name,url,sha256,size)]); file_path(name) KeyErrors on an unpinned name. Store.require_ready(id) raises ModelNotReady (API -> 409) when files absent/invalid. API routes: APIRouter(dependencies=[Depends(require_token)]); recognizer cached on app.state and built lazily; decode/validate errors -> typed 422, ModelNotReady -> 409, misconfig -> 500; single-worker ThreadPoolExecutor + asyncio.wait_for(timeout) for inference. Tests use conftest.prefetched_models_dir() to gate real-model tests; extend it for the new ONNX models. Coordinate frame: ALL bboxes in rendered-image pixels, top-left origin; the only pdfium point(bottom-left,72dpi)->pixel conversion site is ingest/pdf.py, unit-tested.
directory_structure: engine/texora_engine/ holds the sidecar: api/ (FastAPI routes: routes.py health+protected, recognize.py snip, hardware.py, models.py, __init__.py exports the routers), recognizers/ (base.py Protocol + enums, factory.py, formula_pix2tex.py), models/ (catalog.py pinned specs, registry.py ModelFile/ModelSpec, store.py require_ready, downloader.py, bundle.py, errors.py, progress.py), db/ (schema/DAO), ensemble/latex.py (validate_and_normalize + KaTeX allowlist), export/mathml.py (latex_to_mathml), pipeline_config.py (load_pipeline_config), settings.py (pydantic-settings), app.py (create_app wires app.state + routers). M3 ADDS: ingest/ (base,pdf,images,detect,preprocess), layout/ (base,factory,born_digital,pp_doclayout_onnx,doclayout_yolo,reading_order), recognizers/ (text_factory,text_ppocr_onnx,text_tesseract + TextRecognizer in base.py), pipeline/ (page_result,assembler), export/ (markdown,latex), api/pages.py. engine/tests/ holds pytest modules + fixtures/ (currently only formula_frac_ab.png) + a new golden/ dir. scripts/ holds build + a synthetic-PDF generator. docs/ holds PROGRESS.md, LICENSES.md, m2-verification.md (mirror for m3). pipeline.yaml at repo root is the stage-id config. .kiro/specs/texora/tasks.md is the authoritative task list to tick.
